documents.title: Offshore wind expansion
documents.text: Offshore wind farms in the North Sea doubled their output this year, and grid operators plan new cables to bring the power ashore.

documents.title: Solar storage
documents.text: Home batteries are helping families store solar power for the evening, which lowers their electricity bills.

documents.title: Harbour flooding
documents.text: Heavy rain flooded the harbour district overnight. Emergency crews pumped water from the streets until morning.

documents.title: Inondations au port
documents.text: De fortes pluies ont inondé le quartier du port pendant la nuit. Les secours ont pompé l'eau jusqu'au matin.

documents.title: Clinic opening hours
documents.text: The city clinic will open earlier on weekdays so that workers can see a doctor before their shift starts.
